description_full: Zijin Gold International Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the exploration, mining, processing, smelting, refining, and sale of gold and other non-ferrous metals. The company's principal products include gold bullion, alloy, doré, bars, and gold concentrate. It operates in Colombia, Suriname, Australia, Tajikistan, Ghana, Guyana, Papua New Guinea, Kyrgyzstan, and Kazakhstan. The company was formerly known as Jinfeng (HK) International Mining Company Limited. Zijin Gold International Company Limited was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong. Zijin Gold International Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Gold Mountains (Hong Kong) International Mining Company Limited.

financial_summary: ZJNGF is a large-cap basic materials business with a $51.8B market cap on $5.4B of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +44% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are expanding by +7.1pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.
Returns on capital run at 19% against a 10% cost of capital — a 10-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat, with gross margins sitting at 36%.

The business throws off $1.8B in free cash flow — roughly 33 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.50× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 84× is fortress-like.

Net dilution runs at 12.4% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 85% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and within its sector the business captures 3.7× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
